Aspect A (knowledge): v08p plus case-specific retrieval of verified literature cards into the judgement session's first message (no precedents), with rules and card priorities chosen so that each finding pattern brings a for/against pair (heart-rate rise K04/K02, no heart-rate rise K08/K36, QRS change or step K14/K18, deep upsloping depression K24, recurrence K42) and one How-to-use line on reading cards by their applies_when.

Aspect A (knowledge): xa02's case-specific card retrieval plus a static Reference knowledge of card-cited for/against facts (heart-rate timing K01-K04/K08/K10/K29, depth K24-K26/K17, position versus ischemic QRS change K12/K14/K16/K18/K19/K28, recurrence and baseline K42/K43/K22/K23/K36) extended with K15 (positional QRS and ST changes are not proportional, so a QRS change below the flag thresholds does not exclude a step-like positional shift) and the matching How-to-use lines.
